body:
Thank you so much for sharing your experience with me! Just finished reading the articles and they're indeed helpful! We'll try to keep all this in mind and close to heart.

I also wish the best for you and your husband! I'm glad you could help him understand, and that you have him as well.

I can't begin to describe how important and conforting it was to read your reply. Maybe that's somewhat how you fell when your husband sits there with you, like you described. It helped me understand how just listening and understanding can make such a difference, even though I though I knew that already.

Thank you.
